name: Media Covers
description: Generates 16:9 adult-rated movie-style AI covers for audio and text library items that are missing an image.
author: binarygeek119

settings.name: includeAudio
settings.description: Generate covers for audio items that have no image.

settings.name: includeText
settings.description: Generate covers for text items that have no image. Uses the text as image content.

settings.name: maxItems
settings.description: Stop after this many covers. Empty or 0 means every matching item.

settings.name: maxTextCharacters
settings.description: How much of a text file to send as image content. Default is 2000.
